Das Skript „WerkFabExport“ einmal in Fus: Set up the script “WerkFabExport” in Fusion once: Utilities → Add-Ins → Scripts and Add-Ins (Shift+S) → “+” → Script from device → choose the folder “WerkFabExport”.
Das Design in Fusion öffnen und das Skri: Open the design in Fusion and run the script. It writes a file “Name.fusion.json”.

Übernommen werden Skizzen, Extrusion, Ro: Sketches, extrude, revolve, hole, fillet, chamfer and shell come over as steps of their own in the timeline. For everything else the script adds the state of the model as STEP, so the shape is right.
